transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I can make a final call on whether to approve the location logistics plan for the East Junction historic railway platform shoot, I need to check in with our technical coordinator and municipal film liaison. Are either of you on this conversation? I'd like to hear if you have any requirements or concerns from your areas regarding the current draft — specifically the rolling camera dolly, 45 personnel on the platform, the conventional portable generator, and the public-street closure from 9:00 PM to 3:00 AM.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical constraint. After a load review with the railway engineer, I confirmed and filed the platform access certificate, and it specifies two hard limits: no rolling dolly may be used on the platform, and no more than 35 production personnel may occupy the platform at once. This certificate has been filed in the technical appendix but hasn't yet been circulated to the location office. The current draft's rolling camera dolly and 45 personnel count both exceed these limits.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a municipal permit constraint. I confirmed with the municipal film office that the permit for this shoot allows only a battery-silent generator — not a conventional portable generator — and the adjacent public-street closure is permitted only from exactly 11:00 PM to 1:00 AM, not 9:00 PM to 3:00 AM as called for in the current draft. This confirmation is in a permit email that is awaiting upload to the production's shared folder.

commitments.detail: Replace the rolling camera dolly with a compliant non-rolling camera support method before resubmission.
Reduce platform personnel from 45 to no more than 35 at any given time, with a call sheet and staging plan reflecting this cap.
Replace the conventional portable generator with a battery-silent generator as required by the municipal permit.
Adjust the public-street closure window from 9:00 PM–3:00 AM to exactly 11:00 PM–1:00 AM as permitted.
Ensure the platform access certificate from the technical appendix is circulated to the location office and incorporated into the revised logistics plan.
Upload the municipal permit confirmation email to the production's shared folder so all parties can reference the approved generator and closure constraints.
